title: Entry Requirements for Each Appointment Series Format
content:
Clinical Operations standard on what must be true of the patient, the clinic, the funding and the file before an Appointment Series of each visit format is set up.

## Who each format is for

| Visit format | Entry conditions |
|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | visit format is telehealth; the funding covers telehealth; a telehealth device and connection check is on file |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | visit format is in-clinic standard |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | visit format is in-clinic extended |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | visit format is aquatic; the clinic has a pool; an aquatic medical clearance is on file |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | visit format is specialty one-on-one in the pelvic health, vestibular or lymphedema program; a credentialed therapist is available |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | visit format is post-operative; the surgery date is on file; the surgical protocol is on file |

## File requirements

| Visit format | Pre-visit clearance required | Clearance required | Clearance dated within (calendar days before the series start date) | Every appointment with a therapist credentialed in the specialty | First post-operative visit no later than (calendar days after the surgery date) | Payment card on file before booking |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | Yes | telehealth device and connection check | 30 | No | 0 (not post-operative) | No |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | No | none | 0 | No | 0 (not post-operative) | No |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | No | none | 0 | No | 0 (not post-operative) | Yes |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | Yes | aquatic medical clearance (pool clearance from the treating therapist) | 30 | No | 0 (not post-operative) | Yes |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | No | none | 0 | Yes | 0 (not post-operative) | Yes |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | Yes | surgeon's post-operative protocol | 90 | No | 7 | No |

A clearance window of 0 days is shown where no clearance is required, and a post-operative figure of 0 where the format is not post-operative.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Post-Operative Priority Visit Series needs the surgeon's post-operative protocol on file, dated within 90 calendar days before the series start date, and its first visit falls no later than 7 calendar days after the surgery date.
- A Specialty One-on-One Visit Series needs no pre-visit clearance, but every one of its appointments is with a therapist credentialed in the specialty, and a payment card must be on file.
